title: Modeling and Composition Design of Low-Alloy Steel's Mechanical Properties Based on Neural Networks and Genetic Algorithms.
summary: The trained model guided composition and heat treatment of five new steel batches; tensile measurements fell within intended design ranges. The result concerns the tested materials design, not predictive accuracy alone.
ai_technology: Forward-selection deep neural network with genetic algorithm
